questions.prompt: What does the model see about a skill before it opens the skill?

options.text: The whole main file and every supporting file
options.explanation: The docs describe loading those only when the skill is used.

options.text: Only its name and a short description
options.explanation: Right. The Claude and OpenAI docs both say discovery uses the name and description. The model decides from them.

options.text: Nothing at all until you name the skill
options.explanation: The name and description are in context so the model can match a job to a skill.

questions.prompt: In OpenAI's Responses API, how do you keep a client job on one skill version?

options.text: Name a version number, such as 2, and not "latest"
options.explanation: Right. The version field takes a number or "latest". A number stays the same when a new version is uploaded.

options.text: Use "latest", which always means the version you tested
options.explanation: "latest" follows the newest upload, so it can change under a running job.

options.text: Leave the version out, so that it never changes
options.explanation: Without a version, OpenAI uses the skill's default version, which can be moved to another one.

questions.prompt: A short kit card is never cached. What is the likely reason?

options.text: Caching works only for images and never for any text
options.explanation: Caching reuses the repeated beginning of a prompt, text included.

options.text: It is below the model's minimum cacheable length
options.explanation: Right. OpenAI and Anthropic both set a minimum. The Claude docs say shorter prompts are not cached, and no error is returned.

options.text: The card must be uploaded as a skill before use
options.explanation: Caching works on any repeated prefix. It does not need a skill.
